items.title: Clarence "Little Dad" Vincent Interview, 1959-12-03
items.q: I used to play with him too. ... Bud Bruchey. He had me, his Fostham, Fostham brother

ctx.x: So we went over there, the brothers looked at us, you know. He was playing music. Punch and, uh, Brother Petit, they were his buddies, you know. And you know, when we meet on the valley, that's what they call it sometimes, by advertising, we buck against one another. And so they say, Kid Punch over here. And the man got scared, you know. He said, he kept me looking at us, and he said, uh, he said, now it's the same band here, Andrew. I said, they playing out there, but we got a better band this time. He said,…
